svg.title: Each original error is at most Tau−430 i ; the triangle inequality costs 1 + β ≤Tau230 i , using 0 < β ≤2 bβk. The signed finite divergence orbit Dd commutes with insertion, transport and pullback on the common window; its seminorm estimate gives the same error for back(DdJ) −I(a5 i DdV ). Real orbit projection places the label in the invariant subspace. Billed coefficients at most two give Ve size at most 2 + 2β; fixed orbit cost c ≥1 gives c(2 + 2β). Eventually 6c ≤t = bβk, t ≥1, so this is at most 6ct ≤t2 ≤t4. Multiplication by a5 i gives the physical budget. The crown bound, common support and TS7 then supply the corrected-divergence probe estimate with its coupling and spacing factor retained. The lifted surgery source retains every address, weight, lens and common chamber. Its finite marker reader TS6 preserves the paid sum; its billed reader TS7 retains the actual coupling difference rather than two independent normalizations. Weighted spectator readout and the invariant detector recover the target vector on the same refinement.
